Results.ReviewText: I’m happy to own a Weber grill! I now have a grill that is dependable and easy to use. I’m looking forward to grilling more often and know that the temperature will hold true. I was impressed with the number of style/model choices there were to choose from.
Results.Title: Dependable grill!

Results.ReviewText: This new Weber grill replaced an older Weber which I had for 23 years! The reason I was able to keep the old one so long is that you can always get replacement parts for Weber grills. The old one was great and this one is even better.
Results.Title: Weber grills are  the best!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill two months ago and I've used it multiple times to cook various meats. All to perfection. The grill heats up fast and cooks the meats throughly. I like the front loading for the propane tank too!!!
Results.Title: I love my Grill

Results.ReviewText: Quick starting fo r gas grill, easy to use, ee putchased tge griddle & now like our grill even more

Results.ReviewText: After using many other brands, I finally stepped up to a Weber.  What a difference.  Fast, consistent grilling.  Very well constructed. Excellent drip catch system with replacement foils.  If you are sick of wrestling with poorly designed and built grills, do not hesitate to make the move.

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber in this series. I love it, but not liking the new model. There’s no back on it but has a door on the front does not makes sense .

Results.ReviewText: This was my first grill as haven’t any place for one. I chose Weber as I know the reputation & it’s a brand we always had growing up. It is super easy to use & I love having the enclosed cabinet below.
Results.Title: Love it!

I ordered a grill cover and was a bit disappointed at how cheaply it appears to be.  It's like a thin plastic.  I've had a competitors grill and it's cover is heavy duty compared to Weber's cover.

This grill did not last even 3 years. The heat was never evenly distributed 
 Very disappointing.  Never will i spend over 500$ on a grill.

Results.Title: Easy

Results.ReviewText: It is the best grill I have owned. Heats up nicely.
Results.Title: Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: I research the E310 and decided it was the right size for us.  The unit was in-stock and was assembled by Lowes and delivered at no extra charge.  The ignition wires were not installed correctly but we figured  that out with little problem.  The only issue I had was hanging the propane tank on the scale.  Difficult for an older person, but my Wife assisted and we now have a technique.  Grill fires right up, gets hot fast and cooks much faster than my old grill.  Thus far, we are very satisfied and recommend the E310 as a great mid-sized choice.
Results.Title: Great Mid-Sized Choice

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, burned out the burner tubes in 2 years, but customer service sent us replacements hassle free.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Overall I've loved this grill and use it almost daily. It heats up quickly and provides plenty of space for most meals. My only complaints are: 1. The exterior enamel started flaking off after I cooked some steaks at a very high temperature, and 2. The back panel is only about 6" high and doesn't provide much protection for the interior (my dog chewed up the grease catcher aluminum foil insert after the first cook).
Results.Title: Great grill for the price

Results.ReviewText: So far so good heats evenly and the construction seems to be good.  The scale is a little tricky because of the different designs of propane bottles.
Results.Title: Nice bbq

Results.ReviewText: Very pleased with this grill. It heats very evenly over the entire cooking surface. Keep it covered!
Results.Title: Great Heat Distribution!

Results.ReviewText: I don't know why I waited so long! Great grill, designed well.
Results.Title: It just works!

Results.ReviewText: The three burners are nice. I also really like the cast iron grill grates.  My previous Weber grill had only two burners. This grill cooks much hotter. The cast iron grates are also an improvement over the grate on my prior grill
Results.Title: This Grill Is Really An Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: Very good at consistant heat across the whole grill. Great temperature control. Easy to clean also.
Results.Title: Best grill for use and great for precision.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
